# «Ελπίδα» Επιστημονικό Κέντρο Φυσικοθεραπείας

> Scientific physiotherapy center in Arta, Greece. Scientific director: Dimitrios P. Tsolas (Τσώλας Π. Δημήτριος). The site is bilingual: Greek (default) at / and English at /en/.

## Contact

- Address: Βασιλέως Πύρρου 15, Άρτα 47100, Greece (15 Vasileos Pyrrou, Arta)
- Phone: +30 26810 73248 (landline), +30 697 287 6704 (mobile)
- Email: info@physioelpida.gr
- Hours: Monday–Friday 09:00–15:00 and 17:00–21:00, Saturday 09:00–15:00, Sunday closed
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Επιστημονικό-Κέντρο-Φυσικοθεραπείας-Ελπίδα-110048058174064
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/physioelpida/
